title: 有馬記念の後に・情熱を世界に！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa is the victor of the dream match. Not only that, she also brought tons of excitement to the crowd and competition as an incredible entertainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the award ceremony, El Condor Pasa declares her intention to make future races just as exciting and entertaining as she takes on the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa has shown her true potential as an entertainer. Cheers and praise echo endlessly at the racecourse.
